inlineContent.text: Verbs represent player actions in the interactive fiction engine. Each verb has a unique
identifier and can be associated with one or more intents that describe the conceptual
For example, the verb “light” might have intents for both
(setting something on fire), allowing the engine to route commands appropriately
based on context and available objects.
